title: French roundup lists 2027 One Piece dates: EB-06 on 29 Jan, OP-19 on 5 Mar, PEB-01 on 23 Apr
detail: A French retailer news post gives EB-06 (29 Jan 2027), OP-19 'Egghead' (5 Mar 2027) and the first Premium Extra Booster PEB-01 (23 Apr 2027). Retailer blog, not Bandai: treat as unconfirmed until the official site shows them.

title: Porto and Sydney regionals (7 Nov): results still not online
detail: Limitless's One Piece list still ends at 26 Jul 2026, so winners and decks are unconfirmed. Nothing new since yesterday.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): Delta Reign second wave due 17 Nov, stock labels unclear
detail: Page lists ETB (€79.99), Display 36 (€239.99), Bundle of 6 (€44.99), 3-pack (€19.99) and booster (€7.99) as pre-orders with arrival 17/11/2026. Only the bundle clearly shows 'En vente'; the other items show both 'Ajouter au panier' and 'Épuisé', so availability is unconfirmed. Also lists Korean m6 Storm Emeralda (booster €4.50, 30-box €119.90).

title: Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck reported for retail today (11 Nov)
detail: A search summary of an ICv2 report gives 11 Nov 2026 for the retail release. I did not open the article, so the date and contents are unconfirmed; check a Réunion shop before counting on it.

title: Price check: no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket: Mew ex 152 7-day avg €84.09 vs 30-day €90.08 (−7%); Pikachu ex 150 €51.38 vs €55.00 (−7%). Both under the 20% threshold and unchanged from yesterday's feed.
